tagline.en_US: Nzbhydra2 is a meta search application for NZB indexers, the spiritual successor to NZBmegasearcH, and an evolution of the original application NZBHydra.

description.en_US: Nzbhydra2 is a meta search application for NZB indexers, serving as an evolution of the original NZBHydra and successor to NZBmegasearcH. It provides unified access to multiple raw and newznab-based indexers. The application allows users to query multiple indexers from one place and connect search results directly to download clients.

tips: Set up indexers and connections to your nzb download applications upon first opening the interface.
